status: exploratory contract saved before matrix inspection or scoring; article and metadata already exposed
units: one reported PAM subject (two CD45 fractions) and one control subject; no population inference
annotation_scope: marker-defined candidates; co-lineage exclusions are an ambient/doublet flag, not validated cell typing or full decontamination
marker_transfer: Ensembl mouse-human homology checked separately; individual markers shown. No full Nb3 panel transfer or pooled transition score.
normalization: natural log1p of 10000 * UMI / total UMI per cell, no integration
summaries: fraction of candidates detecting each readout
comparisons: individual-marker differences in library summaries only if both primary libraries meet coverage; no biological confidence intervals or p-values
sensitivity: fixed stricter QC; retain all markers and outcomes even if discordant
missing: unmapped or absent features reported as missing; never replace by zero or another feature
ambient_limit: filtered matrices plus multi-feature and co-lineage exclusion only; do not interpret low-level isolated epithelial RNA in immune cells as epithelial state
restrictions: no tissue-wide composition comparison across sorted fractions
no state-transition timing or mature-function claim
no selecting cells by target or transition readouts
figures: per-library dot plot separated by candidate group
marker differences across QC rules if eligible
